<style type="text/css">
html {
   overflow-y: scroll;
}

body {
   padding: 0;
   margin: 0;
   -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
   font: 13px/1.231 arial, helvetica, clean, sans-serif;
}

body.warn-page {
   background: #ffffcc;
}

#page-container {
   margin: 0;
   padding: 0;
   min-width: 1275px;
}

.kdp-top-header {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/kindlepubs/common/layouts/nav-bar-bg._V156427298_.png")
      repeat-x scroll 0 0 transparent;
   height: 29px;
}

.header-row {
   background-color: #F5F5F5;
   padding-top: 6px;
   padding-bottom: 3px;
}

.top-links {
   padding: 5px 20px;
   text-align: right;
}

.top-links a, .top-links .language-chooser, .header-item, .header-item .language-chooser {
   margin: 0 10px;
}

.kdp-delim {
   color: #CCCCCC;
}

.language-option {
   font-size: 11px;
}

.language-option a {
   margin: 5px;
}

.language-option .disable {
   color: #666666;
   margin: 0 5px;
}

body .kdp-header {
   color: #004B91;
   height: 95px;
   padding: 35px 0 0 0;
   position: relative;
   text-align: left;
}

.a-lt-ie8 body .kdp-header {
   height: 90px;
}

.tabs {
   color: #004B91;
   font-family: Arial;
   text-decoration: none;
}

.kdp-header .tabs {
   font-size: 16px;
}

.kdp-header .tabs .kdp-delim {
   padding: 0 15px;
}

.kdp-header .tabs .selected {
   font-weight: bold;
}

.account-incomplete {
   margin-top: 1em;
   position: absolute;
   right: 0;
   top: 0;
}

.account-incomplete .a-alert-content {
   font-size: 13px;
   color: #333;
}

.kdp-top-footer {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/kindlepubs/common/layouts/footer-top._V192549182_.gif")
      repeat-x scroll 0 0 transparent;
   height: 23px;
   margin-top: 1em;
}

.social-footer {
   color: #666666;
   text-align: left;
}

.kdp-footer {
   color: #666666;
   text-align: left;
   font-family: Verdana, Geneva, Sans-Serif;
   font-size: 10px;
   margin: 20px 0;
   padding: 0 10px;
   position: relative;
}

.social-footer .links a, .kdp-footer .links a {
   color: #666666;
   text-decoration: underline;
}

.social-footer .links, .kdp-footer .links {
   text-align: center;
}

.kdp-footer .cr, .kdp-footer .kdp-social, .kdp-footer .links {
   padding-top: 10px;
}

.kdp-social a {
   display: inline-block;
}

.kdp-facebook {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/find-us-on-facebook-intl._V142003952_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
   cursor: pointer;
   height: 20px;
   margin-right: 10px;
   width: 75px;
}

.en_US .kdp-facebook {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/find-us-on-facebook-a._V151334219_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
}

.ja_JP .kdp-facebook {
   background: url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/jp/sprite-kdp-jp._V135734257_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 -2820px transparent;
   height: 22px;
   margin-right: 15px;
   width: 73px;
}

.kdp-twitter {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-x-intl._V1736794651_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
   cursor: pointer;
   height: 20px;
   width: 73px;
}

.en_US .kdp-twitter {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-x-a._V1736794567_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
}

.ja_JP .kdp-twitter {
   background: url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/jp/sprite-kdp-jp._V135734257_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 -2861px transparent;
   height: 22px;
   width: 78px;
}

.kdp-instagram {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-instagram-intl._V1736453912_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
   cursor: pointer;
   height: 20px;
   width: 82px;
}

.en_US .kdp-instagram {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-instagram-a._V1736454729_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
}

.social-footer .kdp-facebook {
   width: 20px;
   margin-right: 5px;
}

.social-footer .kdp-twitter {
   width: 30px;
}

.social-footer .kdp-instagram {
   width: 30px;
}

p.agreements-instructions {
   margin: 0 0 7px 5px;
}

.kdp-header .kdp-header-text {
   font-size: 28px;
   font-weight: normal;
   color: black;
   line-height: 1.2;
   text-align: center;
}

a:link.footer-link, a:visited.footer-link  {
   font-family: arial, sans-serif;
   color: rgb(153, 153, 153);
   text-decoration: none;
   line-height: 11px;

            <h2 class="a-spacing-small help-title">
               What is an ISBN and Imprint Name?
            </h2>
            <div class="a-section a-spacing-large help-body">
               <!--<h2>What is an ISBN and Imprint Name?</h2>-->
<!--https://ajuda.amazon.com/cms?object=G7DMSKCM9DVS65TC-->
<!--https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G7DMSKCM9DVS65TC-->
Discover what ISBNs do and how imprint names are associated with those unique numbers.<br> 
<br>
<h3 style="color: orange">What is an ISBN?</h3>
An ISBN is a unique 13-digit number assigned to majority of published book. It typically starts with 978 or 979, and identifies various attributes about a book (e.g. edition, publisher name, page count, etc.).
<br><br>
ISBNs are used by booksellers, libraries, publishers, and retailers (like Amazon) to identify the book, manage their inventory, and list it for sale. Amazon also assigns an ASIN (Amazon Standard Identification Number) to each book, which is similar to an ISBN. When you publish through KDP, you’ll notice both numbers are assigned to your book.
<br><br>
If you are publishing a low-content book, you can choose to either use your own ISBN or publish without an ISBN. If you publish without an ISBN, we’ll automatically assign an ASIN for your book. Learn more about <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/GGE5T76TWKA85DJM">low-content books</a>. 
<br><br>
<b>Note</b>: An ISBN is required for publication of paperback and hardcover books. eBooks don’t require an ISBN number to be published on KDP.
<br><br>
<h3 style="color: orange">What is an Imprint?</h3>
Imprint names are another way books are identified, beyond using an ISBN. Publishers often release books under a different name than their company name, i.e. an imprint. Example: Penguin Random House is the publishing company name, but they often issue books under the imprint, Penguin Classics.<br><br>
If you’ve registered your ISBN with an imprint outside of KDP, you’ll need to provide both pieces of information exactly how they’re registered, so we can validate your book. However, if you’re using KDP’s free ISBN, we’ll automatically assign your imprint as “Independently published.”<br>
<br>
<h3 style="color: orange">More ISBN resources</h3>

</ul>

            <h2 class="a-spacing-small help-title">
               Content Guidelines
            </h2>
            <div class="a-section a-spacing-large help-body">
               <p><br></p><!--<h2>Content Guidelines</h2>-->
<!--https://ajuda.a2z.com/cms.html?repo=GQRG9D4WWKTRVGY2&object=G200672390-->
<!--https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G200672390-->
As a bookseller, we believe that providing access to the written word is important, including content that may be considered objectionable. We carefully consider the types of content we make available in our stores and review our approach regularly, listening to feedback and investigating concerns from our customers. We reserve the right to remove content from sale if we determine it creates a poor customer experience.
<br><br>
Authors, publishers, and selling partners are responsible for adhering to our content guidelines. We invest significant time and resources to enforce these guidelines, using a combination of machine learning, automation, and dedicated teams of human reviewers. We’ll reject or remove content that does not adhere to these guidelines and promptly investigate any book when notified of potential noncompliance.  We may also request additional information relating to your book before it's available for sale. If we remove a title, we let the author, publisher, or selling partner know and they can appeal our decision.
<br><br>
These guidelines apply to book content, including title, cover art, and product description. 
<br><br>
<b>Note:</b> Books that are translations of another work must credit the translator and the original author in the contributor field. If the work is not a new translation and the translator is unknown, the publisher should list the translator as "Anonymous" in the contributor field.
<br><br>
<h3>Contents</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="#illegal">Illegal or infringing content</a></li>
	<li><a href="#offensive">Offensive content</a></li>
	<li><a href="#aicontent">Artificial intelligence (AI) content</a></li>
	<li><a href="#customerexperience">Poor customer experience</a></li>
<li><a href="#publicdomain">Public domain content</a></li>
<li><a href="#Score and lyrics">Score and lyrics for songs managed by copyright management companies (Japan Only)</a></li>
	<li><a href="#report">Report violations</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
	<a name="illegal"></a>
<h3>Illegal or infringing content</h3>
We take violations of laws and proprietary rights very seriously. It is the responsibility of authors, publishers, and selling partners to ensure their content doesn't violate laws or copyright, trademark, brand, privacy, publicity, or other rights. We will not accept content under copyright that is freely available on the web unless it’s provided by the owner of the copyright. In addition, we do not allow companion books based on copyrighted works (e.g., summaries, study guides, etc.) to be published outside the U.S. without written permission from the copyright holder.
<br><br>
<hr>
	<a name="offensive"></a>
<h3>Offensive content</h3>
We don’t sell certain content including content that we determine is hate speech, promotes the abuse or sexual exploitation of children, contains pornography, glorifies rape or pedophilia, advocates terrorism, or other material we deem inappropriate or offensive.
<br><br>
<hr>
	<a name="aicontent"></a>
<h3>Artificial intelligence (AI) content (text, images, or translations)</h3>
We require you to inform us of AI-generated content (text, images, or translations) when you publish a new book or make edits to and republish an existing book through KDP. AI-generated images include cover and interior images and artwork. You are not required to disclose AI-assisted content. We distinguish between <b>AI-generated</b> and <b>AI-assisted</b> content as follows:
<br><br>
<ul>
<li><b>AI-generated</b>: We define AI-generated content as text, images, or translations created by an AI-based tool. If you used an AI-based tool to create the actual content (whether text, images, or translations), it is considered "AI-generated," even if you applied substantial edits afterwards. 
</li>
	<li><b>AI-assisted</b>: If you created the content yourself, and used AI-based tools to edit, refine, error-check, or otherwise improve that content (whether text or images), then it is considered "AI-assisted" and not “AI-generated.” Similarly, if you used an AI-based tool to brainstorm and generate ideas, but ultimately created the text or images yourself, this is also considered "AI-assisted" and not “AI-generated.” It is not necessary to inform us of the use of such tools or processes.</li>
</ul>
<p>You are responsible for verifying that all AI-generated and/or AI-assisted content adheres to all content guidelines, including by complying with all applicable intellectual property rights.</p>
<hr>
	<a name="customerexperience"></a>
<h3>Poor customer experience</h3>
Books for sale on Amazon should provide a positive customer experience. We do not allow descriptive content meant to mislead customers or that doesn't accurately represent the content of the book. We also do not allow content that’s typically disappointing to customers, including the examples provided in the <a href="/help?topicId=G200952510">Guide to Kindle Content Quality</a>. We reserve the right to change the <a href="/help?topicId=G200652170">categories</a> of a book at any time to ensure a positive customer experience.
<br><br>
<hr>
	<a name="publicdomain"></a>
<h3>Public domain content</h3>
We allow content that is in the public domain and no longer under copyright. However, to provide a better customer experience, we won’t allow undifferentiated versions of public domain titles if a free version is available in our store (as outlined in our policies for <a href="/help?topicId=G200743940">Publishing Public Domain Content</a>). We may ask publishers to provide proof that the content is in the public domain.<p> <br>
</p><hr><br><a name="Score and lyrics"></a>
<h3>Score and lyrics for songs managed by copyright management companies (Japan Only)</h3> Content containing scores and lyrics from songs managed by copyright management companies, including JASRAC, cannot be published on the Kindle Store.<p><br></p><hr>
	<a name="report"></a>
<h3>Report violations</h3>
If you believe a book violates our guidelines, please <a href="/help?topicId=G200652490">report it</a>.
<br><br>
Guidelines for other categories of products can be found here:

<ul>

</li><li><a href="https://www.amazonregistry.com/legaldocs?docId=acceptableusepolicy" target="_blank">Amazon Registry</a>
</li></ul>

         <div class="a-section a-spacing-large">
            <h2 class="a-spacing-small help-title">
               Get an ISBN
            </h2>
            <div class="a-section a-spacing-large help-body">
               <p>You can use a free ISBN provided by KDP or purchase your own from an official ISBN agency. This article explains both options and walks you through how to get and use an ISBN on KDP.</p>
<br>
<hr>
<h3>Get free ISBN from KDP</h3>
<p>Free ISBNs are <b>only</b> available for paperback and hardcover books. Choosing this option means KDP will register an ISBN, using your book details, with Bowker (US ISBN agency).</p>
<p>To get a free KDP ISBN:</p>
<ol>
	<li>Go to your <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/bookshelf">KDP Bookshelf</a>.</li>
	<li>Click the ellipsis button ("...") next to the book you want to add an ISBN to.</li>
	<li>Select <b>Edit Paperback Content</b> or <b>Edit Hardcover content</b>.</li>
	<li>In the <b>ISBN</b> section, choose <b>Get free KDP ISBN</b>.</li>
	<li>Click <b>Assign ISBN</b>.</li>
</ol>
<p><b>Note:</b> <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/GGE5T76TWKA85DJM">Low-content books</a> are not eligible for free ISBNs.</p>
<p>Hardcover publishing is not supported on kdp.amazon.co.jp. </p>
<hr>
<h3>Purchase your own ISBN</h3>
<p>You can buy an ISBN from agencies like Bowker and use them to publish a book on KDP. This ISBN can be used to publish the same book on other publishing services. Make sure it’s registered with the correct <b>title, author name, format, and imprint (i.e. publisher name)</b>.</p>
<p>Bowker does offer <a href="https://www.myidentifiers.com/cart/add_sku/ISBN_1_AMZN">discounted rates for KDP authors</a>, if you'd like to buy an ISBN from them.</p>
<p>To use a purchased ISBN on KDP:</p>
<ol>
	<li>Go to your <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/bookshelf">KDP Bookshelf</a>.</li>
	<li>Click the ellipsis button ("...") next to the book you want to add an ISBN to.</li>
	<li>Select <b>Edit Paperback Content</b> or <b>Edit Hardcover content</b>.</li>
	<li>In the <b>ISBN</b> section, choose <b>Add your own ISBN</b>.</li>
	<li>Enter the details. We recommend copying and pasting directly from the ISBN agency to avoid mismatch errors.</li>
</ol>
<p><b>Note:</b> You don't need an ISBN for eBooks on KDP.</p>
<br>
<hr>
<h3>Summary of ISBN Options</h3>
See the difference between the two ISBN options you have in KDP:<br>
<br>
<table style="width: 80%;" cellspacing="5" cellpadding="5" border="1">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="60">
<p><b>ISBN options</b></p>
</td>
<td width="47">
<p><b>Cost</b></p>
</td>
<td width="77">
<p><b>Publishing</b></p>
</td>
<td width="108">
<p><b>Publisher Imprint</b></p>
</td>
<td width="108">
<p><b>Publisher field in the Book’s detail page</b></p>
</td>
<td width="100">
<p><b>Requirements</b></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="60">
<p><b>KDP Free ISBN</b></p>
</td>
<td width="47">
<p>Free</p>
</td>
<td width="77">
<p>Only with KDP</p>
</td>
<td width="108">
<p>Automatically registered as “Independently published” in Bowker</p>
</td>
<td width="108">
<p>It will show imprint name “Independently published”.</p>
</td>
<td width="100">
<p>We’ll register your free ISBN, so no further requirements are needed from your end.</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p><b>Your own ISBN</b></p>
</td>
<td>
<p>You cover the cost of the ISBN</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>You can publish outside of KDP</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>Register your own imprint with Bowker or local ISBN agency</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>It will show the imprint name you enter to publish your book.</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>When entering your <span>book’s </span>details ensure the information you are providing matches with the information you’ve registered in Bowker. You won’t be able to publish your book if there are any mismatches between this information. The Imprint field has a limit of 100 characters.</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p></p>

            <h2 class="a-spacing-small help-title">
               What is an ISBN and Imprint?
            </h2>
            <div class="a-section a-spacing-large help-body">
               <!--<h2>What is an ISBN and Imprint?</h2>-->
<!--https://ajuda.amazon.com/cms?object=G201834170-->
<!--https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G201834170-->
<p>When publishing a book with KDP, you’ll be asked to provide an ISBN and imprint (i.e. publisher). This article explains what an ISBN and imprint are, while detailing requirements for publishing.</p>
<br>
<hr>
<h3>What is an ISBN?</h3>
<p>An <b>ISBN</b> (International Standard Book Number) is a unique identifier for books. It helps bookstores, libraries, distributors, and readers find and reference your book correctly. Each format of your book (paperback vs hardcover) needs its own ISBN. eBooks and <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/GGE5T76TWKA85DJM">low-content books</a> are the only formats where an ISBN is optional.</p>
<p>The same ISBN cannot be reused across <b>multiple book formats</b> or <b>new editions</b> that introduce significant changes from the original version.</p>
<p>KDP allows two options for ISBNs:</p>
<ol>
	<li>You can use a <b>free ISBN from KDP</b> (paperback and hardcover books only).</li> 
	<li>You can <b>purchase your own ISBN</b>.</li>
</ol>
<p><b>Note:</b> </p><p></p><ul><li>Free ISBNs from us can only be used on KDP. They cannot be used to publish outside of KDP.</li><li>Hardcover is currently unsupported in JP.</li></ul><p></p>
<p>If you purchase your own ISBN, you must enter the same details (i.e. book title, author name, publisher) in KDP that you used to register the ISBN.</p>
<br>
<hr>
<h3>What is an Imprint?</h3>
<p>An <b>imprint</b> is the name of the publisher associated with your book’s ISBN. If you buy your own ISBN, you can list your own publishing imprint (such as your business or brand name). If you use a free ISBN from KDP, the imprint will appear as <b>“Independently published.”</b></p>
<p>If you use your own ISBN, KDP will check whether your book’s imprint matches what’s on file with the ISBN agency (e.g. Bowker). If there’s a mismatch, you won’t be able to publish.</p>
<p><b>Note:</b> 
<p><ul><li>Entering ISBN and imprint details are case-sensitive. Even extra spaces at the end of the imprint name can cause mismatch errors. Do not enter placeholders, such as “unknown” or “n/a.”
<li>The Imprint field has a limit of 100 characters. </li></ul></p><br>
<hr>
<a name="Compare_ISBN"></a>
<h3>Helpful resources</h3>
<ul>

	<li><a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G8BYTM8CVK74676V">Change or view your ISBN</a></li>

	<li><a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G5HDYGP4BXLX4RUW">Barcodes with ISBNs</a></li>
</ul>
